component.name: USB Disk Imager
component.summary: Read USB drives and memory cards into image files and write them back

description.p: A raw disk imager for USB drives and memory cards. It reads a device into an image file, writes an image file back onto a device, and compares the two byte for byte.

A read can stop at the end of the data instead of copying the whole medium: either after the last partition — rebuilding GPT metadata so the shorter image stays valid — or after the last sector that is not entirely zero.
Devices are discovered without opening volumes that are not partitions of a physical disk, so virtual volumes from disk-encryption tools are left alone rather than waited on.
